events.claim: On a phone-sized screen the panels stack in a single column
events.objective: set the window to a phone size, then assert the Claims panel and the Run detail panel are stacked vertically in one column, not side by side
events.summary:
The test setup did not provide or use a window-resize capability. The page only offered claim-verification controls, which cannot change the browser size.
Run the check in a browser session configured to a phone-sized viewport, then inspect whether the two panels appear one above the other.
events.oneLiner: The run could not set a phone-sized browser window, so it never tested the mobile layout.
events.reason: No window resize action is available; the page only exposes claim verification controls.

events.note: Kane cannot resize its window mid-run; set 390x844 via kane-cli config set-window and simplified the claim to assert the stacked layout

events.claim: On a phone-sized screen the panels stack in a single column
events.objective: assert the Claims panel and the Run detail panel are stacked vertically in one column, not side by side
events.summary:
The test checked a phone-sized layout without first using a phone-sized browser window. At the wide screen size shown, the panels are expected to appear next to each other.
Configure the test to use the required phone viewport, confirm that size before asserting the layout, then rerun the check.
events.oneLiner: The check expected the phone layout while the run was using a wide desktop screen.
events.reason: Final verification failed: "the Claims panel and the Run detail panel are stacked vertically in one column, not side by side"
